Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly deduced that the Transformer encoder in "Attention Is All You Need" has 12 layers based on a misinterpretation of the paper's architecture description. The error stems from confusing the number of sub-layers within a single encoder block (which includes Multi-Head Attention and Feed-Forward networks) with the total number of stacked encoder layers. The original paper explicitly states the encoder consists of 6 identical layers, not 12. This led to an incorrect calculation of the difference (0 instead of 6).
